# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c34 P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c34 P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Stella is a vivid girl with black eyes and a rose-red complexion. She is considered a great beauty, carrying off the palm for looks in her Second Year classes at Redmond.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Stella possesses a heartful of wistful, rainbow-like dreams and fancies. She is an intimate friend of Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- Vivid  <sub>[v1 c34 P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004)</sub>
- Imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Stella Maynard attended Redmond College as a student at the same time as Anne Shirley. During their Second Year, she formed a close friendship with Anne and Priscilla Grant, becoming part of their inner circle of thoughtful and ambitious friends.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Affiliations

- Redmond College — Student  <sub>[v1 c34 P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004)</sub>
